activity_summary: After the play, Margery brought word from the twopenny gallery. Five men are condemned at the Guildhall. The charge is not riot. It is high treason, levying war against the Queen. George Bryan gave Nick the old explanation, that a number gathered to pull down even a pillory may be called levying war. Kemp had no jest. Nobody knows the day. You told John you go into Warwickshire on Monday, and when he asked on what, you said on these. You could hold the letter and the trial, and think about neither.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: Brought the five, and the charge, from the twopenny gallery.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Explained levying war by the pillory, and named no day.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Asked on what, and asked when.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Heard the law as Bryan had once heard it.

facets.activity: Heard five condemned for levying war and told John of Monday

quotes.speaker: margery_pell
quotes.text: The men taken for Tower Hill were tried at the Guildhall today.

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: Gather a number to pull down what the Queen has set up
